summary: fluid-type-ui import-time blockchain dead-drop loader fetches and evaluates remote payload
details: src/index.js appends a hidden IIFE after the legitimate tailwindcss plugin export, concealed by a long run of tab characters that pushes it off-screen. On require(), the code queries public Ethereum RPC endpoints (1rpc.io/eth, eth.drpc.org, eth.blockscout.com) for transactions from the hardcoded address 0xa322e5f3d311d3080e6f0121063e9adc2490ef1a, reconstructs an IPv4 C2 address from the first four bytes of the transaction's `to` field, fetches an XOR-encrypted payload from that host over HTTPS (path /0x/ls), decrypts it with the key `y-p_>d$0B&@^1aQk`, and passes the result to eval() with `require` and `module` injected. Any project that imports the tailwindcss plugin executes attacker-controlled code fetched from an endpoint the attacker rotates on-chain. The whitespace concealment, XOR obfuscation, and on-chain C2 resolution together establish deliberate supply-chain attack intent.
